reason: A DSH web UI theme plugin that applies a hiking-inspired light and dark skin, provides skin switching in settings, and adds a Waypoints progress panel without changing interface logic.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供山野向导风格的亮暗主题、设置中的皮肤切换入口和右侧路标进度面板。
summaries.en: Adds a hiking-inspired light and dark theme to the DSH web interface, with a settings skin switcher and a right-side Waypoints progress panel.

capabilities: injects CSS into the DSH web interface
adds a settings entry for switching skins
adds a right-side Waypoints progress panel
